keyEvents.text: Brad Potts (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ben Wilmot (Stoke City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Djibril Soumaré (Stoke City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Stoke City 1, Preston North End 0. Ben Wilmot (Stoke City) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jack McGlynn with a cross following a corner.
Luca Bombino (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Preston North End. Thierry Small replaces Brad Potts.
Second Half begins Stoke City 1, Preston North End 0.
Goal! Stoke City 2, Preston North End 0. Jack McGlynn (Stoke City) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ethan Galbraith.
Substitution, Preston North End. Andrew Moran replaces Delano Burgzorg.
Substitution, Preston North End. Jusef Erabi replaces Callum Lang.
Substitution, Stoke City. Junior Tchamadeu replaces Luca Bombino.
Substitution, Stoke City. George Hirst replaces Róbert Bozeník.
Ethan Galbraith (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stoke City. Million Manhoef replaces Justin Devenny.
Substitution, Stoke City. Svante Ingelsson replaces Djibril Soumaré.
Substitution, Stoke City. Maksym Talovierov replaces Bosun Lawal.
Substitution, Preston North End. Stanley Mills replaces Johnny Kenny.
Jusef Erabi (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Stoke City 2, Preston North End 0.
